children: Serina Therapeutics reported that the Independent Safety Monitoring Committee cleared SER-252 to advance to Cohort 2 after blinded Cohort 1 showed sustained apomorphine exposure and encouraging motor improvements.
SMC completed blinded review of Cohort 1 and recommended advancing the Phase 1b registrational study to Cohort 2.
Cohort 1 (lowest single-ascending dose, n=8) showed pharmacokinetics consistent with sustained apomorphine exposure.
Blinded observations included sustained periods of motor-function improvement in individual patients on exploratory measures.
Safety and tolerability in Cohort 1 supported dose escalation to subsequent cohorts.
Company expects to report topline data from the single-ascending-dose portion in H1 2027.
